note: Analyst Shark · bored-investor angle. Plan is process-heavy and serial; findings only elevated when they threaten a North Star criterion (delivery of open/run/stop/restart + diagnose/attach honesty, named states, cost truth, no v1.1.x ship, S1-only NS claim).

findings.section: Success criteria; Waves 10–19; Wave 1 task triple
findings.criterion: On branch v1.2, John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work
findings.message: The North Star leads with four verbs. The plan names a verification task triple of open/run/stop-restart in W1, then spends surface waves on attach, usage, cost, Doctor, stop summary, restart, preview, projects, and cadence. There is no wave whose done-when is “open real Anchor work works end-to-end or fails with a named state,” and none for “run.” Stop and restart get W15–W16; attach gets W10. Open and run are either assumed already perfect (unproven in this draft) or silently omitted. A bored investor funds open/run/stop/restart; this plan only budgets the last half and a side attach. Either add open/run surface waves bound to inventory PRESENT|STUB|ABSENT, or freeze an explicit inventory verdict that open/run are PRESENT with transcripts and no further work—do not leave the first two North Star verbs as ambient hope.

findings.criterion: without meeting … a silent zero, a mislabelled empty … (unknown ≠ empty ≠ zero)
findings.message: W11’s acceptance says a PROVEN rollup that “genuinely returns zero rows for today” renders empty, “distinct from both unknown and zero_measured.” Zero rows for a measured day is measured zero activity, not an empty collection in the “no data domain” sense. Teaching the surface to label measured absence of events as empty reintroduces the exact mislabelled-empty / silent-zero class the North Star bans—especially once cost and usage sit on the same chrome. Empty must mean “no series / no scope,” zero_measured must mean “rollup ran and the total is 0,” unknown must mean “we did not successfully read.” Fix the Given/When/Then and the failure-state table before this wave can claim criterion 3.

findings.section: Wave 5 — Wave-list freeze + doc-trio amendment; Wave 3 inventory
findings.criterion: On branch v1.2, John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work — including Doctor diagnose and session attach
findings.message: W3 can reclassify any control to STUB → “build it,” and W5’s DOC-TRIO-AMENDMENT lets those waves be inserted indefinitely with only a re-freeze. There is no cap on inserted waves, no “must still hit S1 on this effort,” and no rule that STUB on a North Star control is either built in-plan or closed with a signed exit—not deferred forever by amendment churn. Bored-investor read: inventory is a blank check that can keep surface delivery (Diagnose, attach, restart) off the calendar forever while still looking “governed.” Bound it: max inserted waves, or mandatory E1/build-now decision per North Star control at freeze, with conjunction scorer already treating serial deferral as re-baseline risk.

findings.criterion: Every surface that claims health, usage, or diagnose either works end-to-end or fails with a named, user-visible state (unknown ≠ empty ≠ zero)
findings.message: The plan’s own law says a property named without a matching obligation is a BLOCKER—and conversely that obligations must be enforced. Honesty (failure-state table; unknown≠empty) is partially wave-local. Idempotence (repeat-invocation), boundedness (numeric bound + refusal), containment (escape-attempt), and storage vocabulary (atomic temp+fsync+rename, cross-process lock, concurrency test) appear as global checklists with no wave that names the bound, the refusal path, the escape test, or the durable write path for preference store (W18), cost migration (W7), inventory/rollup artifacts, or EXECUTION-LOG. Claiming durability/honesty guarantees while product surfaces only assert “three labels differ” is confident process theater: the North Star needs failure honesty on real health/usage/diagnose paths, not a second copy of journal 0080 with unchecked boxes. Either map each obligation to a concrete wave acceptance criterion or drop the claim so the plan does not advertise unenforced guarantees.

findings.section: Wave 6 NamedState; Hardening failure-state table vocabulary; wave-local failure-states/*
findings.criterion: fails with a named, user-visible state (unknown ≠ empty ≠ zero)
findings.message: W6 ships NamedState (ok, unknown, empty, zero_measured, pending, unmeasured, measurement_failed, timeout, cannot_retry). Hardening vocabulary demands five different rows (dependency-missing, dependency-slow-or-killed, dependency-returns-garbage, backing-store-unreadable, empty-but-valid) with status codes per surface verb. Surface waves only promise “unknown and empty as separate rows.” No mapping table says which NamedState is dependency-returns-garbage vs backing-store-unreadable. Two parallel honesty languages means implementers will satisfy the easier checklist and leave the required five as prose. That is how “named state” becomes “we showed unknown somewhere.” Require one vocabulary (or an explicit bijection enforced by the table validator) before any surface wave is GO.

findings.criterion: On branch v1.2, John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work — including Doctor diagnose and session attach
findings.message: Nine waves of ledgers, exit registers, inventory, rollup gates, freeze stamps, named-state primitives, cost enums, conformance harnesses, and trace plumbing precede the first user-facing attach honesty (W10). None of W1–W9 lets John open, run, stop, restart, diagnose, or attach on v1.2. Bored investor: all capital can be spent and still deliver zero North Star verbs if Phase 0/1/2 stalls. Process floor is defensible; a fully serial nine-wave tax before any vertical slice is not. Collapse or parallelize Phase 2 primitives with one thin end-to-end path (e.g. attach or Diagnose) so a mid-build halt still leaves a working surface, not only green pytest on governance modules.

findings.criterion: including Doctor diagnose and session attach … Every surface that claims health, usage, or diagnose
findings.message: Attach (W10) blocks usage (W11) blocks cost (W12) blocks Doctor (W13–14) blocks stop (W15) blocks restart (W16) blocks preview (W17) blocks projects (W18) blocks cadence (W19). Doctor does not need usage tiles; restart does not need PDF preview; cadence does not need projects collapse. Artificial total order delays diagnose and restart—the named North Star inclusions—behind unrelated surfaces. Investor view: longest possible critical path maximizes calendar risk of never reaching S1 with the verbs that matter. Re-express dependencies as true data/contract edges (named_state, rollup_registry, inventory row) only; allow parallel surface waves after freeze.

findings.section: Wave 1 task triple; Wave 5 freeze; Wave 21 S1
findings.criterion: Steward conversational proof is a post-build validation session (S1), not a silent claim of this build. / John can open, run, stop, and restart…
findings.message: W1 forbids E5 on the task triple and HALTs without John’s dated line; W5 requires John’s Phase-1 verdict review before any surface wave; W21 requires live S1. S1 as the only North Star claim is correct and in-scope. Stacking two additional hard live-John gates before any product wave means the build cannot advance through process phases without calendar attendance—while the North Star still depends on a fourth live session at the end. Bored investor: three human appointments on the critical path, two of them before value. Keep S1 sacred; make W1/W5 either pre-seedable from a prior signed artifact with expiry, or allow orchestration to proceed on captured transcripts with a single re-confirm at freeze—not a hard stop that strandsthe entire NS delivery on scheduling.

findings.criterion: without meeting … a preview that dumps raw binary
findings.message: W17 intent and deliverables assume “the already-working new-window path” and only “route” formats through it. That assumption is not bound to a W3 PRESENT verdict or a freeze delta. If inventory says STUB/ABSENT, this wave as written ships theater or a dead path—exactly the raw-binary / dead-control failure mode. Freeze must either insert a build-it wave for the shared renderer or mark ABSENT with a named unsupported state for all Office/PDF; W17 must not hard-code “already-working.”

findings.criterion: On branch v1.2, John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work — including Doctor diagnose and session attach
findings.message: There is no milestone where a single North Star verb is done under real UI with named failure states before the full ten-criteria matrix. Governance is front-loaded; product is back-loaded. If conjunction re-baseline HALTs at four exits mid-surface phase, John may have exit_register.py and freeze stamps but still meet dead Diagnose or dishonest attach. Define an ordered minimum slice (e.g. attach + stop + one restart context + Diagnose) that may reach a partial honest state without claiming full North Star—explicitly partial, not silent green—so investment is not all-or-nothing at W21.

W7 adds a schema migration and backfill to unmeasured, and bans $0.00 fabrication at render time. It does not specify failed-migration behavior, partial backfill, or what the UI shows if cost_state column is missing mid-deploy—i.e. dependency-missing / backing-store paths from the plan’s own failure vocabulary. A half-migrated DB is the classic path back to “0 ⇒ subscription” or blank dollars. Require named measurement_failed/unmeasured when schema or backfill is incomplete, and a gate that refuses measured rendering until migration attestation is host-verified.

findings.criterion: Nothing in this effort ships to v1.1.x collaborators
findings.message: Branch/channel non-publication is only enforced in the final wave. Intermediate commits on a mistaken branch or packaging path are unchecked until S1. Cheap refinement: run release_guard (or a one-line branch assertion) from W1 containment smoke onward so the collaborator boundary is continuous, not a last-day checkbox.

findings.criterion: Nothing in this effort ships to v1.1.x collaborators (handoff/root foreign artifacts untouched as plan success criterion supporting isolation)
findings.message: Success criteria promise root foreign Foreman artifacts untouched; the only Given is a write to DESCRIPTION.md. Byte-identity of one file does not prove the write-target allowlist or other root artifacts. Broaden the smoke to the ledger’s full foreign-artifact set or narrow the claim—overclaiming containment is the same honesty defect class the plan polices elsewhere.

findings.criterion: On branch v1.2, John can open … real Anchor work (projects UI as open-path hygiene—weak but plan-listed)
findings.message: Projects collapse is in the draft success criteria but is not named in the North Star paragraph (no dead control / diagnose / cost / binary). As bored investor it is polish on the critical path after restart and Doctor. If inventory shows it is cosmetic, demote behind NS verbs or accept only after open/run/stop/restart/diagnose/attach are honest; do not let dual-profile preference work delay S1 on the core verbs. If you keep it, state the North Star link (open-path dead UX) in one line so it survives inclusion.

Top-level test-command is node scripts/run-all-tests.mjs while every wave gate is scoped pytest. Out of inclusion for North Star severity; still a Foreman foot-gun if the aggregator does not invoke the same suites. Align or document the aggregator’s inclusion list—demoted under inclusion test.
